status: DRAFT - every rule below requires validation by a Sri Lankan tax professional before reliance
legislation: Inland Revenue Act No. 24 of 2017, as amended (incl. the amendments effective from 1 April 2025)

personal_relief.ref: IRA 2017 Fifth Schedule (as amended from 1 April 2025)

bands.ref: IRA 2017 First Schedule para 1(1)(a) (as amended from 1 April 2025)

rent_relief_rate.ref: IRA 2017 Fifth Schedule: relief of 25% of rental income

foreign_service.label: 15% maximum - qualifying foreign service income
foreign_service.ref: IRA 2017 First Schedule (as amended from 1 April 2025): qualifying foreign service income at a maximum rate of 15%, subject to statutory conditions

qualifying_payment_cap.ref: IRA 2017 s.52 & Fifth Schedule: qualifying payments are subject to limits - enter the allowable amount

qualifying_export_services.label: 15% - Qualifying Export Service Income
qualifying_export_services.ref: IRA 2017 First Schedule (as amended): concessionary rate for qualifying export of services, subject to conditions

standard_rate.label: Partnership income tax rate
standard_rate.ref: IRA 2017 s.53 and First Schedule (as amended): tax on a partnership's taxable income; the partners are taxed on their shares as individuals - to be validated

balancing.label: Balancing charge / allowance on disposal
balancing.ref: IRA 2017 Third Schedule & s.17-18: proceeds against the tax written-down value - confirm the treatment

intangibles.label: Intangible assets
intangibles.ref: IRA 2017 Third Schedule: over the useful life - enter the allowance

carry_forward_years.label: Years a loss may be carried forward
carry_forward_years.ref: IRA 2017 s.19 - confirm the limit for the year

restriction.ref: IRA 2017 s.19: business and investment losses carried forward; confirm any restriction for the category

dividend_final.ref: IRA 2017 Fifth Schedule (final WHT on dividends to residents)

interest.ref: IRA 2017 s.85 as amended (WHT on interest - confirm the rate and whether creditable)
